method.alignment: Whisper small multilingual int8 cross-attention forced alignment of TTS text to the audio; cue boundaries derive from word timings.
method.recognition: The same model transcribed each block separately using a generic Hinglish style prompt, without the lesson text as a prompt.
method.human_review: No human listening or verbatim certification has been performed; automatic recognition and alignment can still be wrong.
